verdict.rationale: Plaid's Transactions docs state that up to 24 months of transaction data can be retrieved and kept current via webhooks, which documents the history depth. The official Node SDK exposes a transactionsSync call, indicating a sync-style endpoint for incremental fetching. missing for 10: explicit evidence of the pagination/cursor mechanics, documentation of how sync returns only added/modified/removed changes, independent hands-on corroboration.
